BOOK ONE · LESSON 084

Have you had ...?

你已经……了吗？

A picture lesson on the present perfect with 'already' and 'just'. Students listen to a recording and answer a question, then study twenty numbered pictures (1,000-20,000) showing foods and drinks: fruit, bananas, oranges, peaches, apples, vegetables, lettuce, cabbage, peas, beans, meat, beef, lamb, steak, chicken, milk, tea, coffee, wine and beer. Written exercises ask students to answer offers using 'I've already had some / one' and to answer questions using 'I haven't had any ... . I've just had some ...'. Workbook practice asks students to reply to offers (yes or no) and to complete two situation dialogues. Grammar exercises ask students to answer 'much/many' questions with 'a lot of' / 'any ... at all', and to give correct replies to 'Let's have ... now' suggestions using 'But I've already had ...'.

Written A — Write responses using some or one

A Write responses using some or one. 模仿例句写出对应的回答，选用 some 或 one。
Examples: Have some coffee. → I've already had some. / Have a banana. → I've already had one.

Write a response to each offer, using 'I've already had some' (uncountable) or 'I've already had one' (countable), following the examples.

Written B — Answer these questions

B Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
Example: Have you had any vegetables or fruit? (I) → I haven't had any vegetables. I've just had some fruit.

Answer each question in the first person indicated, saying you haven't had one thing but have just had the other, following the example.
